import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer, with_timeout

CLK_NS = 10
TIMEOUT_NS = 2 * CLK_NS


async def rise(dut):
    await with_timeout(RisingEdge(dut.PCLK), TIMEOUT_NS, "ns")


async def fall(dut):
    await with_timeout(FallingEdge(dut.PCLK), TIMEOUT_NS, "ns")


async def cycles(dut, count):
    await with_timeout(ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, count), (count + 1) * CLK_NS, "ns")


async def start(dut):
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.io_in.value = 0
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await cycles(dut, 2)
    await fall(dut)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await cycles(dut, 5)


async def apb_write(dut, addr, data):
    """Perform a setup cycle followed by one APB access cycle."""
    await fall(dut)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 1
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = data
    await fall(dut)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await rise(dut)
    await fall(dut)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0


async def apb_read(dut, addr):
    """Read PRDATA during the APB access phase."""
    await fall(dut)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    await fall(dut)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    value = int(dut.PRDATA.value)
    await rise(dut)
    await fall(dut)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    return value


async def check_read(dut, addr, expected):
    actual = await apb_read(dut, addr)
    assert actual == expected, (
        f"PRDATA at {addr:#010x}: expected {expected:#010x}, got {actual:#010x}"
    )


async def check_irq(dut, expected):
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.IRQ.value) == expected, (
        f"IRQ: expected {expected}, got {int(dut.IRQ.value)}"
    )

    dut.io_in.value = 0
    await cycles(dut, 7)

    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF0C, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    await cycles(dut, 4)

    ris = await apb_read(dut, 0xFF08)

    assert ris & edge_mask == 0

    await check_read(dut, 0xFF04, 0)

    await cycles(dut, 5)

    assert await apb_read(dut, 0xFF04) == (1 << 16)

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0x0004) == 0xE7

    # Unmapped writes and writes to read-only registers have no effect.
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0010, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF04, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF08, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0x0004) == 0xE7
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0xFF08) == 0x0000FF00

    # Masking controls MIS and IRQ; RIS remains independent of the mask.
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF00, 0x00000100)
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0xFF04) == 0x00000100
    assert int(dut.IRQ.value) == 1
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF00, 0)
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0xFF04) == 0
    assert int(dut.IRQ.value) == 0
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0xFF08) == 0x0000FF00

    # Raise pins 0 and 3. Their high-level and rising-edge status must set.
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF0C, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 4)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.io_in.value = 0x09
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 6)
    ris = await apb_read(dut, 0xFF08)
    assert ris & (1 << 0)
    assert ris & (1 << 3)
    assert ris & (1 << 16)
    assert ris & (1 << 19)
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0x0000) == 0x09

    # Edge status is sticky after the input transition has finished.
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF0C, 1 << 16)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)
    ris = await apb_read(dut, 0xFF08)
    assert (ris & (1 << 16)) == 0
    assert ris & (1 << 19)

    # Lowering pins produces falling-edge status; earlier sticky status remains.
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.io_in.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 6)
    ris = await apb_read(dut, 0xFF08)
    assert ris & (1 << 24)
    assert ris & (1 << 27)
    assert ris & (1 << 19)

    # Clear an edge bit after its pulse is over; it must remain cleared.
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF0C, 1 << 24)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)
    ris = await apb_read(dut, 0xFF08)
    assert (ris & (1 << 24)) == 0
    assert ris & (1 << 27)

    # A level condition sets again on the edge after IC's one-cycle clear.
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.io_in.value = 1 << 2
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 6)
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0x0000) == (1 << 2)
    assert (await apb_read(dut, 0xFF08)) & (1 << 2)

    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF0C, 1 << 2)
    dut.PADDR.value = 0xFF08
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await ReadOnly()
    assert (int(dut.PRDATA.value) & (1 << 2)) == 0
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await ReadOnly()
    assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) & (1 << 2)

    # IRQ follows the masked status, including a currently asserted level.
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF00, 1 << 2)
    assert int(dut.IRQ.value) == 1
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0xFF04) == (1 << 2)
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF00, 0)
    assert int(dut.IRQ.value) == 0

    # Outputs do not feed the input path, regardless of direction settings.
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0004, 0xFF)
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0008, 0xFF)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 4)
    assert int(dut.io_out.value) == 0xFF
    assert int(dut.io_oe.value) == 0xFF
    assert await apb_read(dut, 0x0000) == (1 << 2)

    # Reset assertion is asynchronous and clears all resettable registers.
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.io_out.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.io_oe.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.IRQ.value) == 0

    for addr in (0x0004, 0x0008, 0xFF00, 0xFF04, 0xFF08, 0xFF10):
        dut.PADDR.value = addr
        await Timer(1, unit="ns")
        assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) == 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0xFF0C
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) == 0xDEADBEEF
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
